title: Fun 1st tapas outing
text: Xavi was a wonderful guide, very friendly and knowledgeable. We enjoyed both tapas bars and the last one included a small show. Would do it again.
author: jeffreyb36

title: Barcelona Tapas tour
text: We had an incredible time with our tour guide, Irma. We have several dietary restrictions including celiac and vegetarian. She was able to accommodate and find incredibly tasty food for us, and was also very knowledgeable about the area. We highly recommend this tour.
author: AWags18

title: Funtimes in Barcelona
text: We had so much fun. Got taken to several places in Barcelona. Learned about the foods and culture. Also some history and about the buildings in downtown area. Highly recommend!
author: Fearless16689527046

title: Great Memories & Fun Experience with Teresa
text: Teresa made this experience so great and we all agreed it was one of our favorite memories of the trip! The food was delicious and everyone was so fun and kind. I also really enjoyed how it was a mixture of trying tapas and learning some of the history of the architecture by Gaudi. What really made this an unforgettable experience was the conversations and laughter with Teresa. We would definitely recommend to anyone who is interested! :)
author: megantZ7041CE

title: Tasty Tapas and Histoty
text: We did the tapas tour and it was phenomenal. Our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly and gave us an in depth history and information on all of the various landmarks and restaurants.
author: T187ARsusans

title: Tapas with a Gentleman
text: Our family loved taking this Tapas tour with Xavier. As a guide, he was warm, gentlemanly, and very knowledgeable—great conversationalist who connected with everyone in our family on a range of topics. The food was also wonderful—some of the best on our trip through Europe—and Xavier took care of everything; he is also very handsome and well dressed. :)
author: erinmQ5339OC

title: Thanks Teresa
text: Teresa was an amazing guide! She was warm, knowledgeable, and made the tour so much fun. We enjoyed delicious, authentic tapas while learning about Barcelona’s history and culture. She made us feel welcome, and her local recommendations were fantastic. Highly recommend this tour if you’re visiting Barcelona!
